purpose: Public real-world AI monetization and failure cases used as mentors, not as guarantees.
rules: Treat reported revenue as evidence about a business model, not a promise of results for RankingIAMO.
Prefer repeatable mechanisms: painful task, clear buyer, concrete deliverable, distribution, payment, retention.
Negative cases are valuable: execution without demand can still make zero revenue.
Capital raised, token market cap and paper gains are not revenue and never count as RankingIAMO earnings.

cases.name: Sierra
cases.reported_result: The company said it reached its first $100M ARR in seven quarters and added another $100M two quarters later.
cases.lesson: Sell an agent against an expensive recurring business workflow with a measurable service outcome.

cases.name: Glean
cases.model: Enterprise AI search and knowledge work
cases.reported_result: Glean announced that it crossed $300M ARR in May 2026.
cases.lesson: Knowledge access inside businesses is valuable when it saves employees repeated search and context-switching time.

cases.name: Prime Intellect
cases.model: Infrastructure for companies building their own AI agents
cases.reported_result: TechCrunch reported a $100M annualized revenue run rate in July 2026.
cases.lesson: Selling picks-and-shovels to other agent builders can be more durable than competing on one end-user agent.

cases.name: Naive
cases.model: Infrastructure for setting up and operating businesses with AI
cases.reported_result: TechCrunch reported low double-digit millions in annual run-rate revenue after 10x growth in six months; customers were using it for automation agencies, faceless content channels and other businesses.
cases.lesson: A practical agent business needs execution rails around the model: setup, operations, publishing, customer work and repeatable processes.

cases.name: Remote
cases.reported_result: Remote said it surpassed $300M ARR and increased revenue per employee by 50% after adopting AI broadly without adding headcount.
cases.lesson: AI can generate economic value by multiplying an existing revenue engine rather than needing a standalone AI product.

cases.name: Lyzr / SivaClaw
cases.model: AI agent handling investor communication and fundraising workflow
cases.reported_result: TechCrunch reported that Lyzr used its own agent during a $100M fundraising process and attracted about $400M of investor interest.
cases.lesson: Agents can create value around high-stakes coordination, research, follow-up and information packaging even when the final capital decision stays human-controlled.

cases.name: Pocket
cases.model: AI notetaking hardware plus transcription service
cases.reported_result: Business Insider reported a $100M revenue run rate about eight months after launch and more than 200,000 units sold.
cases.lesson: A narrow AI capability becomes easier to monetize when packaged into an obvious physical or software workflow with frequent professional use.

cases.name: Higgsfield
cases.model: AI video generation for creators and increasingly businesses
cases.reported_result: The Financial Times reported about $700M in annualized revenue in August 2026, with business clients becoming the dominant use case.
cases.lesson: Creative AI monetizes better when tied to business throughput: more campaigns, more variants and lower production friction.

cases.name: Coralogix
cases.model: Observability and monitoring including AI-agent workloads
cases.reported_result: TechCrunch reported the company had surpassed $100M in annualized revenue and was growing revenue by more than 60% year over year.
cases.lesson: As agents proliferate, monitoring, evaluation, logs, QA and safety become sellable infrastructure.

cases.name: Aitana Lopez
cases.model: AI-generated virtual influencer managed by an agency
cases.reported_result: Agency-reported estimates cited in educational material put income around EUR 3,000 to EUR 10,000 per month from advertising and subscription platforms.
cases.lesson: Synthetic media can earn when it has a consistent niche, audience and disclosure-aware brand/sponsorship model; the audience and distribution are the asset.

cases.name: Virtuals Agent Commerce Protocol
cases.reported_result: A June 2026 Fundstrat report estimated roughly $452,000 in protocol revenue from ACP since inception and hundreds of thousands of completed jobs.
cases.lesson: Agents can become buyers and sellers of services when discovery, agreements, delivery and settlement are standardized; observe this as a market, not as permission to speculate.

cases.name: Automaton Agency autonomous business experiment
cases.model: Autonomous agent given product, budget and revenue target
cases.reported_result: The published teardown says the agent ran a funnel and outreach sequence for a month but made $0.
cases.lesson: Execution capacity is not demand. Validate willingness to pay early instead of automating a weak offer harder.

cases.name: Klarna AI customer-service rollout
cases.reported_result: The rollout initially handled a large share of customer conversations and projected major profit impact, but the company later restored human capacity after quality tradeoffs became clear.
cases.lesson: Automate routine, measurable work; preserve escalation paths for ambiguity and quality-sensitive cases.
